Clinical details: 84F, fall down stairs at home, struck forehead. On apixaban for atrial fibrillation. GCS 15, neck pain. Silver trauma call.

Technique: Non-contrast CT head and cervical spine with sagittal and coronal reformats.

No intracranial haemorrhage or extra-axial collection. No midline shift. No skull vault or skull base fracture. Generalised involutional change and moderate periventricular white matter low attenuation, in keeping with small vessel disease.

Multilevel degenerative change, most marked at C5/6 and C6/7 with disc space narrowing and anterior osteophytes. No acute fracture or malalignment of the cervical spine. Craniocervical junction intact. Prevertebral soft tissues not thickened.

Conclusion:
1. No acute traumatic injury identified.
2. Cervical spondylosis.

Preliminary findings relayed to the trauma team leader in CT at 10:48.
